highestCommercialGoal: Turn the existing public GitHub traffic entry into a trustworthy API-free BossAI domestic ecommerce customer-service connector reference that routes qualified users toward the BossAI ecosystem without claiming unavailable marketplace production access.
largestUserGap: The published v1.0.0 Community Demo still presents legacy direct-provider, auto-reply, polling and widget concepts that no longer match the governed BossAI customer-service architecture.
userProblem: A developer or merchant evaluating BossAI needs a runnable Douyin/Taobao reference without merchant API credentials, with clear safety boundaries and a credible path into canonical BossAI Customer Service.
userVisibleChange: Visitors can run a synthetic signed-webhook demo with no real platform API, inspect canonical connector envelopes and human-review rules, and use a diagnostic UI that never claims automatic customer actions.
scope: signed inbound channel normalization and stable idempotency
canonical BossAI Customer Service intake bridge
mandatory human-review and fail-closed external-action policy
public-source GitHub CI, docs, security and lead-generation positioning
outOfScope: claiming real Douyin/Taobao merchant API authorization
refund, cancellation, replacement, compensation or order/account mutation
creating another Agent Runtime, approval authority or customer-service state authority
moving or overwriting the existing v1.0.0 tag/release

npm run test:e2e passes the local HTTP entry, signed callbacks, canonical intake stub and fail-closed external-action tests
npm run verify:channel-adapter confirms BossAI OS/canonical customer-service authority boundaries
npm run verify:public-release confirms public-source metadata, license, CI and secret hygiene
